At an average market price of ₹1,200/tonne, the plant’s annual revenue potential is ~₹13.1 crore, representing ~1.1 % of MBAPL’s FY24 revenue (~₹1,200 crore). • Financial Relevance: With an estimated operating margin of ~10 %, the plant could add ~₹1.3 crore to EBIT, a bolt‑on contribution that is material to the PA segment but modest to the overall group. • Strategic Positioning: The new PA unit enhances MBAPL’s downstream portfolio, supports customer ramp‑up, and positions the company to capture growing domestic demand for phosphoric acid, while aligning with its execution timeline for expanding fertilizer and agro‑chemical offerings. 🎯 Analyst Watchlist: ↳ • Monitor ramp‑up to full 300 TPD capacity and associated cost controls. ↳ • Track integration with existing manufacturing lines and any regulatory approvals that may affect output. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
